title: The Bank Heist That Shocked America

scenes.text: In 1997, two heavily armed men attempted to rob a bank in North Hollywood.
This robbery involved an astonishing $9 million in cash and valuables.
scenes.query: close-up of bags filled with cash

scenes.text: It turned into a 44-minute gun battle with LAPD, one of the longest in U.S. history.
The twist? The robbers were eventually killed, but the stolen money was never recovered.
Follow for the cases that were never solved.

description: In 1997, a dramatic bank heist in North Hollywood unfolded into one of the longest gun battles in U.S. history. Discover what happened next! #shorts #truecrime #heist #bankrobbery #unsolvedmysteries #fyp
